snippet.title: UNLISTED Far Far West - Gameplay Trailer with BearBoo, Cheebiez, Shakey and TheHotCross
snippet.description: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive. https//store.steampowered.com/app/3124540/Far_Far_West/
